tagline: Full-stack developer, DevOps engineer and lecturer. I build my college's digital infrastructure and web services that are a pleasure to use
about_statement: I build and deploy digital solutions for education: from the college website and an e-signature service to a unified access infrastructure on FreeIPA and Keycloak. I like complex things built simply.
position: Head of the Department of Information Resilience and Digital Innovation and lecturer at Nizhny Tagil College of Trade and Economics

work_caption: Web apps I designed and shipped to production
packages_caption: Open-source packages and services for the college's internal Laravel apps: SSO, user directory, personal data protection, Max notifications

services.name: Emodrom
services.description: A web app for a psychology-based party game about emotions: the host console, projector display, and players' screens update in real time.

services.name: NTCTE website
services.description: The college's official website: news, documents, sections for applicants, students and parents, an accessible version, and a dark theme.

services.name: Signatus
services.description: The college's e-signature service: signing, previewing, and archiving documents with corporate accounts.

packages.name: Max SDK
packages.description: PHP SDK for the Max messenger Bot API: typed client, bot routing, webhooks and long polling, Laravel and Symfony bridges.

packages.name: Rupor
packages.description: Notification hub delivering messages to Max: one shared college bot, staff account linking and delivery for services over a signed API.

packages.name: Transliteration
packages.description: Cyrillic transliteration per ICAO Doc 9303 and login generation for staff and students with free-login resolution.

packages.name: Personal data classification
packages.description: Mark personal data fields with PHP attributes on models and DTOs, plus an artisan report for the information systems registry.

packages.name: Keycloak JWT
packages.description: A stateless API guard: verifies Keycloak tokens via JWKS, RBAC on roles and FreeIPA groups, Back-Channel Logout.

packages.name: FreeIPA directory
packages.description: Resolves a user's full FreeIPA group chain by recursive membership traversal, with caching and fail-closed behavior.

packages.name: Personal data audit log
packages.description: Structured logging of personal data reads and writes with a single model trait, the basis for 152-FZ safeguards.

packages.name: Unified API response
packages.description: A data / meta / errors JSON envelope, end-to-end request_id, locale detection, and consistent exception rendering.
